record.what_it_does: Plaid provides APIs that let apps connect to users' bank and financial accounts to retrieve account, balance, transaction, identity, income, and other financial data, and to move money.
record.auth_notes: Core API auth is a client_id + secret pair sent in the request body or as PLAID-CLIENT-ID/PLAID-SECRET headers (not a standard OAuth2 flow). A separate OAuth2 client_credentials flow (scope mcp:dashboard) is used only to obtain a short-lived bearer token for the Dashboard MCP server, not for the main financial-data API.
record.access_notes: Sandbox (mock data) credentials are free and instant after Dashboard signup. Real Production access requires an application review by Plaid (company + use-case info, ~a few business days) and, outside the new free Trial plan (10 Items, 8 core products, US/CA developers signing up on/after 2026-04-15), a paid plan.
record.main_blocker: Real bank data requires Plaid's Production approval (or the capped Trial plan); the official MCP server only exposes Dashboard diagnostics/analytics tools, not the core financial-data endpoints (Auth, Transactions, etc.), so an agent toolkit for those must call the REST API directly.
